page.layout: One printed block only: a bookplate in the centre-right reading "Ex Bibliotheca / majori Coll. Rom. / Societ. Jesu", with a handwritten shelf mark "III. 14. a" beneath it. Top left: a library stamp (digitiser/library stamp, not transcribed). Handwritten pencil and ink marks at the foot and a Google watermark at the lower right are not printed text.
page.notes: The library stamp (a star-shaped octagon reading "BIBLIOTECA NAZIONALE VITTORIO EMANUELE" with "9 / 14 M B / 7") and the handwritten marks ("III. 14. a", the pencil numbers at the foot such as "9 Litt 2", and the "Digitized by Google" watermark) are not printed text and are omitted. The bookplate text is transcribed as printed; the shelf mark is handwriting and is not included in the main text.
